//: Worked example: connect McpLense to a Microsoft Agent365 MCP endpoint via Entra ID.
//1: This file is an *auth profile* config (Phase A): it describes HOW to authenticate, not
//2: WHICH server to connect to. The same profile services every Agent365 MCP under a tenant
//5: Drop this file into one of:
//8: or pass it explicitly with: mcplense inspect <url> --profiles ./agent365.json
//10: On Windows without XDG_CONFIG_HOME, McpLense falls back to %APPDATA%\McpLense.
//11: On Linux/macOS without XDG_CONFIG_HOME, McpLense falls back to ~/.config/McpLense.
//14: VSCODE_CLIENT_ID  Public client application id. For Microsoft first-party services
//16: CORP_TENANT_ID    Your tenant GUID, domain name, or one of 'common', 'organizations',
//17: 'consumers'. Omit (and remove the tenantId line) to default to
//19: VSCODE_AUDIENCE   Application ID URI of the Agent365 resource you are targeting,
//21: The literal '/.default' suffix below must remain; it tells Entra to
//22: issue a token carrying every statically-consented permission.
//24: Tokens are cached in the OS credential store under the profile name ('agent365' here),
//25: so each profile gets its own MSAL cache file. Set 'cacheName: "mcp-proxy"' to share
//26: the cache with the mcp-proxy tool.
